title: Assess and plan home
caption: The organiser opens Assess and plan and sees the assessments started from the signed baseline.

title: Source map with four zones
caption: Lens places every source on a map of impact against readiness, split into four zones.

title: One source opened
caption: Opening a source shows why Lens scored it that way, the measures it feeds and what is still missing.

title: Request sent to owners
caption: Lens writes a plain request for each source owner, with a private upload link shown once.

title: Owner uploads by link
caption: A source owner sends their file through the link without signing in and sees what arrived at once.

title: Profile of an uploaded file
caption: After an upload Lens shows each column, how full it is, and a list of gaps.

title: Reported figures mapped
caption: The office's own monthly figures are matched to measures, and unmatched lines wait for a person to choose.

title: Scan: custody file gaps
caption: The scan shows the custody file stops on 22 September although the period runs to 30 September.

title: Scan: index levels gap
caption: The index levels file also stops on 22 September and Lens says so.

title: Scan: how full columns are
caption: The performance workbook shows asset class 90 percent full and fees charged only 50 percent full.

title: Trial table before checking
caption: Lens compares its own figure with the figure the office reports, measure by measure, and says why they differ.

title: Rules marked as checked
caption: The analyst marks each written rule as checked and the table records who did it.

title: Findings in three groups
caption: Findings are sorted into ready to build, unclear and unknown, each with its reasons.

title: Risks to accept
caption: The sponsor sees every risk Lens lists and can accept it or send it back with a reason.

title: One risk sent back
caption: The sponsor sends one risk back with a written reason and the count shows it.

title: Remaining risks accepted
caption: Accepting the rest in one action leaves only the risks the sponsor may not see.

title: Sent-back risk re-checked
caption: After the trial is run again the sent-back risk returns marked as re-checked for a decision.

title: All risks decided
caption: Every risk now has a recorded decision and the plan can be signed.

title: Plan in three bands
caption: Lens drafts a phased plan in Now, Next and Later, with effort, blockers and who unblocks them.

title: Ready for the sponsor
caption: The sponsor sees who must sign and that signing locks the plan.

title: Sponsor has signed
caption: The sponsor's signature is recorded and the page now waits for the head of data.

title: Head of data's turn
caption: The head of data opens the plan and sees the sponsor's signature and their own sign button.

title: Plan signed by both
caption: Both signatures are recorded and the plan is read-only and ready for the build.

title: Signed plan is read-only
caption: After signing, the risks and plan show no buttons to change anything.

title: Signed state with Nira
caption: The top of the signed page with Nira's side panel, which still shows the earlier waiting message.
